subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR require redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the credential gap for this narrow source-level fix?
rationale: The contributor disclosed that they do not have a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and ClawSweeper cannot create the missing real-service proof from source tests alone.

options.title: Require or provide live proof
options.body: A contributor or maintainer supplies redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact showing endpoint detection selecting the coding endpoint after this change.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: A maintainer records that the linked issue's live service behavior plus the narrow header diff and regression test are sufficient for this PR.

recommendation.title: Require or provide live proof
recommendation.body: A contributor or maintainer supplies redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact showing endpoint detection selecting the coding endpoint after this change.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the Z.AI endpoint detection and GLM-5.2/Coding Plan behavior that this PR repairs.
